description: Add the MODEL-FACING surface so a user can drive the four Phase-6a capabilities from Copilot: a concise Tier-0 section, a Tier-1 prompt (apia-share), and a Tier-2 skill (apia-share). Because VS 2022 honors only Tier-0 + Tier-1 prompts, the sharing capability MUST be fully usable by a single agent via the prompt/Tier-0. Depends on FEAT-002 (the CLI entry points must exist).
steps: Tier-0: in .github/copilot-instructions.md add a VERY concise 'Share (local, git-based)' section covering export/import a knowledge pack, apply an org/team profile (local overrides win), local plugins (adapters/scanners/shapes as committed files), and the capability manifest - naming share.py and deferring detail to /apia-share. The file is at 6362 bytes against a ~6500 ceiling: keep the addition minimal and, if needed, tighten existing prose (e.g. the 'Where the detail lives' list) to stay UNDER ~6500 bytes. Verify the final byte count with `wc -c`.

Create .github/prompts/apia-share.prompt.md (Tier-1) following the apia-run.prompt.md pattern: YAML front-matter (description, agent, read-only tools like apia-run uses: search/codebase, search/usages, web/fetch), a body that carries the WHOLE sharing flow as a single Tier-0/Tier-1 agent so it works on VS 2022: the exact share.py commands for --export-pack/--import-pack/--apply-profile/--manifest/--plugins/--doctor (+ --json), the SAFE-merge/no-clobber behavior, profile precedence, plugin contract pointer to .apia/adapters/README.md, and the honest framing (LOCAL git-based only; NOT a hosted platform/cross-org/marketplace). Human-gated; strictly local; no external LLM.

Create .github/skills/apia-share/SKILL.md (Tier-2) following the apia-orchestrate/SKILL.md pattern: name==dir name (apia-share), description, and (context: fork only if the flow is heavy). Document the model-vs-off-model split (share.py does the deterministic export/import/merge/profile-layer/plugin-discovery/manifest; Copilot only summarizes/decides at the human gate), the steps, and the same honest framing + constraints.

If the agent surface pattern requires it, reference the new prompt/skill from the relevant read-only agent(s) under .github/agents/ consistent with how apia-orchestrator wires apia-run (keep agents read-only: search/web tools only).
Validate: front-matter YAML parses; SKILL.md name matches its directory; Tier-0 under ~6500 bytes.
acceptance_criteria: .github/copilot-instructions.md contains a concise sharing section and is < ~6500 bytes (verified by wc -c).
.github/prompts/apia-share.prompt.md exists with valid YAML front-matter and carries the full flow usable by a single VS-2022 agent.
.github/skills/apia-share/SKILL.md exists with name==dir and valid front-matter.
All referenced share.py commands match the CLI actually implemented in FEAT-002.
verification: .venv/bin/python -c "import yaml,glob; [yaml.safe_load(open(p).read().split('---')[1]) for p in glob.glob('.github/prompts/apia-share.prompt.md')+glob.glob('.github/skills/apia-share/SKILL.md')]"  -> parses with no error
findings: Added the model-facing surface for Phase-6a sharing. (1) Tier-0 .github/copilot-instructions.md: added a concise 'Share (local, git-based)' section naming share.py + all four capabilities (versioned knowledge pack with SAFE no-clobber merge incl. --force opt-in and unknown schema_version reported-not-applied; org/team profile .apia/profile.yml merged UNDER local config so local wins; committed local plugins under .apia/plugins/ additive + malformed-reported; capability manifest), deferring detail to /apia-share; added /apia-share to the Prompts line and apia-share to the Skills line. The file started at 6362 bytes; the addition pushed it to ~7186 so existing prose was tightened across the loop/self-correction/review/orchestrate/generate/anti-hallucination/helpers sections and headers. Final size verified by `wc -c` = 6489 bytes (< ~6500). (2) Created .github/prompts/apia-share.prompt.md (Tier-1) following the apia-run.prompt.md pattern: front-matter description + agent: apia-orchestrator + read-only tools [search/codebase, search/usages, web/fetch]; body carries the WHOLE flow as a single Tier-0/Tier-1 agent for VS 2022, with the exact share.py commands for --export-pack/--import-pack(+--force)/--apply-profile/--manifest/--plugins/--doctor (+ --json), the SAFE-merge/no-clobber + unknown-version behavior, profile precedence + provenance, plugin contract pointer to .apia/adapters/README.md (and .apia/plugins/README.md), and the honest framing (LOCAL git-based only; NOT hosted/cross-org/marketplace; human-gated; strictly local; no external LLM). (3) Created .github/skills/apia-share/SKILL.md (Tier-2) following apia-orchestrate/SKILL.md: name==dir (apia-share), description, model-vs-off-model split (share.py does the deterministic export/import/merge/profile-layer/plugin-discovery/manifest; Copilot only summarizes + decides at the human gate), steps, honest framing + constraints. No context: fork (the sharing flow is lightweight, not heavy graph reasoning). (4) No new agent wiring needed: the prompt reuses the existing read-only apia-orchestrator agent (search/web tools only), mirroring how apia-run is wired, and is self-contained for VS 2022. Validation: front-matter YAML of both files parses (yaml.safe_load); SKILL.md name == its directory (apia-share); Tier-0 < ~6500 bytes (6489). All referenced share.py flags were confirmed present in the FEAT-002 CLI and the commands (--doctor/--manifest/--plugins/--apply-profile) smoke-tested exit 0; referenced paths (.apia/profiles/example-team.yml, .apia/plugins/README.md, .apia/adapters/README.md) exist. Docs/surface-only change (no Python touched); per task guidance the full pytest suite was not run. Did not commit or stage (per orchestrator briefing).
